name: beam
title: Beam
description: A field of hairlines. The pointer carries a beam across them: the lines under it swell into bars and part to make room, and the beam glides after the pointer.
docs: One self-contained file, react only: no Tailwind, no other dependency. Mount <Beam /> inside an element with position: relative and a size; it covers that element and is decoration only: give it no link or click handler. Suggested commit: feat: add Beam hover texture (textures.dev/s/beam)
